sloka: पौरेषु यदि ते प्रीतिर्यदि स्नेहो ह्यनुत्तमः ।सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थ समागच्छाम सत्पथम् ।। ७.१०७.१३ ॥
transliteration: paureṣu yadi te prītiryadi sneho hyanuttamaḥ ।saputradārāḥ kākutstha samāgacchāma satpatham ।। 7.107.13 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, if you truly have unsurpassed affection and love for your citizens, then let us all, with our children and wives, accompany you on your path.
